title: Slap
blurb: Sharp, crisp and considerably louder than physics permits. Cinema slaps have been amplified beyond realism for decades, built by foley artists from leather, gloves and enthusiastic hand-clapping, because a genuine slap sounds disappointingly soft and audiences flatly refuse to accept it. Editing inherited the whole convention. It works on a reality check landing, a punchline arriving, or the exact moment somebody says a thing that deserves consequences. One of the most-used impacts in the business, and we are happily continuing the tradition of overstating it.
